event_name: SAUDI ARABIAN GRAND PRIX 17 - 19 March 2023 Technical Delegate's Report
from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 13:36 2023 SAUDI ARABIAN GRAND PRIX 17 - 19 March 2023 Technical Delegate's Report Last night team personnel of the BWT Alpine F1 Team team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the twelve and a half hour period which commenced at 01:00 on 18 March, fifteen and a half hours before the scheduled start time of P3 and ends three hours before the scheduled start time of P3 at 13:30 on 18 March. This was the first of the two individual exceptions permitted for the BWT Alpine F1 Team team during the 2023 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate From The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate To The Stewards Jo Bauer
